title: Does word salad help a RAG reader? A pre-registered paired test of the Power-of-Noise random-word claim with a local model

cost.compute_notes: NQ-open test questions with gold passages from HF florin-hf/nq_open_gold (test_dataset.json, 2,058,173 B, sha256 6393c942...). Model qwen3.5:4b (4.7B, Q4_K_M) via local Ollama 0.33.3, greedy (temperature 0, seed 0), thinking off, num_ctx 4096. 597 questions x 3 conditions = 1,791 calls, ~4-5 s per call on the local GPU, about 2 h wall-clock in background. qwen3:4b was tried first and rejected because it ignores think:false.

triggers: does random noise in the context help retrieval-augmented generation
power of noise replication small model
irrelevant documents in RAG context effect on accuracy
pre-registered paired test RAG context composition

claims.statement: Adding five length-matched word-salad documents (tokens sampled from the passage unigram distribution) before the gold passage does not change exact-answer accuracy of a 4.7B local model on NQ-open: 78.4% vs 78.6% gold-only, difference -0.2 points, 95% CI -2.7 to +2.4, discordant pairs 29/30, exact McNemar p = 1.0.
claims.scope: One model (qwen3.5:4b Q4_K_M), oracle setting (gold passage always present, placed last = nearest the question), K = 5 added documents, 597 randomly ordered NQ-open test questions, Power-of-Noise-style extraction prompt and answer-containment metric.

quantities.name: accuracy_difference_word_salad_minus_gold_only
quantities.baseline: gold only 0.7856; cuconasu2024#c4 reports +3.0 points (0.2198 -> 0.2499) with 10 random-word documents added to 8 retrieved, Llama2

quantities.name: accuracy_difference_unrelated_wikipedia_minus_gold_only
quantities.baseline: discordant 20/33, exact McNemar p = 0.098; direction opposite to cuconasu2024#c2

our_assessment.why: Analysis plan fixed before any outcome was inspected (reanalysis/ANALYSIS_PLAN.md, 15:46, after 32 questions). One deviation: the plan's stop time (17:45) passed while the session was paused, and the background job ran to 597/600 before its time limit; no outcome had been looked at and the stop did not depend on the data. By the pre-stated rule the word-salad result is INCONCLUSIVE against a +2-point effect (upper CI +2.35) but excludes the paper's own +3.0-point size in this setting. Random real passages, if anything, hurt (-2.2 points, n.s.). Narrow on purpose: one small model, oracle setting, 5 not 10 added documents, gold-only base rather than 8 retrieved. It does not refute the Power-of-Noise effect; it fails to find its strongest, mechanism-diagnostic form where it should be easiest to see.

artifacts.locator: artifacts/results_qwen3.5_4b.jsonl (597 questions x 3 conditions: response, correctness, seconds, prompt tokens)

checked.result: 2,889 questions with gold passage text; some answers carry U+FFFD in place of diacritics in the source data (e.g. 'R\ufffdntgen'); normalisation treats both sides identically. Open with encoding='utf-8' on Windows.

relations.why: Independent test of c4 (random-word documents help) and c2 (random documents help) in the oracle setting with a different, smaller model.
Both find the Power-of-Noise gain fragile outside its original setting.

open_questions: Same design with 10 added documents and 8 retrieved (the paper's exact Table 4 setting) -- needs a retriever over the 21M-passage corpus or the authors' retrieval files.
Same design with two or three more local models (the effect may be model-specific; Cuconasu found it strongest in some models).
Position: word salad placed AFTER the gold passage (gold far from the question) -- the paper's 'Far' setting.
